text:
Aisha R: Heads-up — I'm 10m from end of shift and we just got a flurry of 503s on embeddings-serving in us-west. I'm still online but need a warm handoff. Incident-bot: Pager triggered: embeddings-serving-us-west latency spike > 2s, error-rate 30% (alert #INC-4821).
incident-bot: Current severity: P2 (auto). Affected routes: /v1/embeddings, /v1/search-rerank.
Tom B: on it, I'm switching my pager to primary. Can you drop the quick triage notes?
Aisha R: quick notes — started ~10:12UTC, some pods restarted around 10:11 (OOM?), `kubectl get pods -n inference | grep embeddings` shows several CrashLoopBackOffs. CPU on node gpu-cluster-03 is spiking. No config changes in the last 24h we know of.
Yuki S: @Tom B if it's node-level, we should look at the node autoscaler and k8s events. Also check the recent quantized model rollout from last night (model v1.3-q). Might be memory regression.
Jordan K: I'm on EU support but can stay on-call if you need cross-region failover checks. For customer comms, product-ops might want a sticky note.
Tom B: Thanks. Running `kubectl describe pod embeddings-xx -n inference` now. Pasting relevant snippets:
```
State:          Terminated
Reason:         OOMKilled
Last State:     Terminated
Exit Code:      137
```
Looks like OOMs. Might be a mismatch between quantized kernels and resident memory.
Aisha R: noting customer impact — several API keys getting 500/503, error rate ~28% for last 8m, examples flagged in logs (customer A and internal smoke tests). No public incident page yet.
Tom B: OK escalation plan proposal: 1) Page infra-oncall for node investigation. 2) Page model-team lead (Yuki) for rollback to v1.2-q. 3) If not mitigated in 15m escalate to eng-lead (Jordan) for incident comms and potential capacity burst.
Yuki S: I agree. Quick rollback: we can pin embeddings-service to model v1.2-q via config flag `MODEL_TAG=v1.2-q` and rollout can be done via `kubectl set env deploy/embeddings MODEL_TAG=v1.2-q -n inference` — but that will trigger new pods; might force more churn. Alternative: scale up node pool temporarily.
Jordan K: If we scale nodes, we may hit quota. Let infra-oncall confirm before scaling. Also consider enabling traffic split to us-east as fallback for new requests.
incident-bot: Noted escalation targets: infra-oncall, model-team, eng-lead.
sre-runbook-bot: Runbook hint: embeddings OOM pattern — see runbook link https://redwood.runbooks/embeddings/ooms. Steps: (A) confirm OOMs, (B) check recent model rollouts, (C) consider rollback or scale, (D) notify customers if >15m degraded.
Tom B: paging infra-oncall now -> +infra-oncall (pager).
Aisha R: paging model-team lead -> @Yuki S (pager). Also pinging product-ops-ops for potential customer alert.
Yuki S: I'm on pager. Reviewing release log: nightly quantized push at 02:00UTC included a kernel change flagged for gpu-compat. No immediate flags pre-deploy. I'll prepare rollback artifact.
Tom B: infra-oncall responded: `infra-oncall: investigating node gpu-cluster-03; noticing oom-kill pattern across pods. Suspect node memory pressure due to nightly snapshot job overlapping with inference workloads.`
Aisha R: that snapshot job should be in a different pool — maybe scheduling drift. Can we cordon node while we scale up?
infra-oncall (via Tom): cordoning node now: `kubectl cordon gpu-cluster-03` and starting scale up of `gpu-pool-nodes` +2. ETA ~7m.
Tom B: while infra scales, Yuki — do you want me to start a canary rollback on 10% of traffic to v1.2-q? That would minimize churn.
Yuki S: Do it. Use traffic-split config: `traffic: {embeddings: [{tag: v1.2-q, weight:10}, {tag: v1.3-q, weight:90}]}` — deploy via infra-config.
Aisha R: small note: if rollback triggers pod churn, error rate might temporarily spike. We'll coordinate with infra.
Jordan K: Decision log: we will scale nodes +2, traffic-split 10% to v1.2-q. If error rate doesn't drop below 5% in 15m, escalate to P1 and page eng-lead oncall.
Tom B: I've applied the traffic-split and triggered the scale. Monitoring logs and metrics: embedding 500s trending down to 12% after 4m.
Aisha R: great. Starting handoff now — I'm done in 5m. Tom, please confirm you're primary and have pager.
Tom B: confirmed — I'm primary. Yuki on model, Jordan as escalation contact. I'm leaving notes in the incident channel and runbook.
Yuki S: monitored rollback — canary v1.2-q pods are stable, mem usage normalized. Pushing to 50% now to speed mitigation.
incident-bot: Alert update: error-rate reduced to 6% (10m), severity remains P2.
Tom B: forwarding to product-ops-ops for customer heads-up: `product-ops-ops: embedding API degradation earlier today, partial mitigation in progress; we'll update in 30m with RCA if stable.`
Aisha R: thanks all. A few handoff items: 1) Tom is primary, Yuki is model lead pager, Jordan is escalation. 2) Runbook link + quick commands added to channel. 3) If nodes finish scaling and errors go <5% keep as P2 and close after 30m stable. If not, escalate to P1 and page eng-lead.
Jordan K: I'll standby for comms and draft a brief customer note if we hit P1.
Tom B: last check — metrics holding at ~4.5% error rate for the last 6m. I'll keep monitoring. Leaving a final note in the thread and update incident ticket INC-4821.
Aisha R: handing off completed. Leaving. :wave:
Tom B: acknowledged. Good handoff. :thumbsup:
sre-runbook-bot: Reminder: after-action tasks: add timeline to runbook, note quantized kernel impact, recommend isolation of snapshot jobs to non-inference nodes.
Jordan K: Adding action item for infra to add affinity rule and for model team to add a preflight memory check for quantized rollouts.
Tom B: closing loop — will update incident ticket with timeline and next steps. If anything degrades ping this thread or page.
